from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import time
def work(n: int) -> int:
    time.sleep(0.01)
    return n * n
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as ex:
    results = list(ex.map(work, range(20)))
print(results)

Async generator
code:
import asyncio
async def ticker(n: int):
    for i in range(n):
        yield i
        await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
async def main():
    async for v in ticker(5):
        print(v)
asyncio.run(main())

title: Context manager
code:
from contextlib import contextmanager
import time
@contextmanager
def timer(label: str):
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    yield
    print(f"{label}: {(time.perf_counter()-t0)*1000:.1f}ms")
with timer("work"):
    sum(range(1_000_000))

title: HTTPX async batch
code:
import asyncio, httpx
URLs = [f"https://httpbin.org/get?n={i}" for i in range(5)]
async def fetch_all():
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as c:
        return await asyncio.gather(*[c.get(u) for u in URLs])
resps = asyncio.run(fetch_all())
print([r.status_code for r in resps])

title: Retry with backoff
code:
retry() {
  local n=0 max=5
  until "$@"; do
    n=$((n+1))
    [[ $n -ge $max ]] && return 1
    sleep $((2**n))
  done
}
